title: 'A border state': Akali leader fuels buzz over SAD-BJP reunion, gives this reason
content: Bikram Singh Majithia of the Shiromani Akali Dal expressed that public sentiment is leaning towards an alliance with the BJP. He highlighted Punjab's strategic location and the importance of social harmony as pivotal factors. The two parties had a longstanding relationship before parting ways over farm laws. Majithia emphasised that the final decision will come from the leadership of both sides, leaving the results of this potential collaboration uncertain.

title: Jantar Mantar sees large anti-reservation protest despite Delhi Police warning
content: A large crowd gathered at Delhi's Jantar Mantar for a protest.  These protesters demanded changes to the existing caste-based reservation system.  Delhi Police had clearly stated that no permission was granted for this demonstration.  Security forces were deployed and barricades were installed as a precautionary measure.  Legal action was warned against those spreading false information about the protest.

title: FIFA bans Leandro Paredes for 10 matches over World Cup final scuffle
content: Argentina midfielder Leandro Paredes has been handed a 10-match ban by FIFA following a scuffle with Spain players moments after the World Cup final. Paredes received the longest suspension among three Argentina players punished for the incident. The sanctions were announced by FIFA on Friday.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct
content: Student protests at Jantar Mantar have prompted political parties to rethink their youth engagement strategies. The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.

title: Elon Musk provides update on first-ever SpaceX Starship upper stage tower catch
content: SpaceX is gearing up for an ambitious mid-air capture of the Starship upper stage, with plans set for the next few months instead of the originally planned late August timeline. Having successfully recovered the Super Heavy booster several times, this new challenge presents complex engineering difficulties related to its high reentry profile. Recent data reflects consistent advancements towards accomplishing this extraordinary goal.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn
content: Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: Family sold 53,000-acre California island for $30m, stayed 25 more years
content: In 1986, the United States government acquired Santa Rosa Island for close to thirty million dollars. This pivotal purchase marked the end of longstanding private ranching and agricultural practices on the sprawling island. Following the removal of cattle in 1998 and the cessation of residency in 2011, efforts towards environmental restoration commenced. Today, the island stands as a protected national sanctuary and an important cultural landmark.

title: US seized California island ranch after $4m offer; jury awarded family $12.7m
content: A federal jury awarded a California family $12.7 million for their Santa Cruz Island ranch.  The government had seized the 6,300-acre property using eminent domain in 1996.  This verdict concluded a decades-long property dispute between park officials and the Gherini family.  The family's ancestors had owned part of the island since the late 19th century.  The award allowed the National Park Service to gain full control of the land.

title: Govt orders Google to shut down hundreds of Firebase accounts over scam misuse
content: Indian authorities ordered Google to close hundreds of Firebase accounts.  These accounts were exploited by criminals for banking scams and malware.  Officials found a pattern of impersonating major banks to defraud users.  The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued multiple notices for account removals.  This action is part of India's increased efforts against online financial fraud.

title: Who pays what in a rental home? Property tax, maintenance and utility bills explained
content: In India, property taxes are fundamentally the responsibility of the property owner as per municipal regulations. Meanwhile, utility expenses for water and electricity are usually settled by the tenant who consumes these services. Maintenance fees of housing societies are generally charged to owners, but tenancy agreements can sometimes allocate part of these costs to renters. Clarifying these responsibilities helps avoid conflicts between landlords and tenants.

title: Fury on Hyderabad street Aston Martin kills Odisha woman, family devastated 1,200km away
content: In a tragic incident, Bharati Mukhi lost her life after being struck by a speeding Aston Martin while crossing the street in Hyderabad. The driver, the son of a Janasena Party MP, is undergoing intoxication testing. Mukhi was the primary breadwinner for her family, who now faces significant financial challenges and seeks government aid. Authorities await forensic and post-mortem reports to continue their investigation.

title: Mendoza's 'no girlfriend' vow faces test as Alysa Liu dating rumors swirl

However, fans are buzzing about his recent outing with Olympic figure skater Alysa Liu. The duo sparked dating speculation after they enjoyed a video game together and were spotted at the renowned 2026 ESPY Awards ceremony.

title: Bold Habs trade pitch for Crosby reignites debate over his future in Pittsburgh
content: A fresh trade suggestion for Sidney Crosby has the Montreal Canadiens and Pittsburgh Penguins at the center of new NHL trade rumors. Toronto sports host Sid Seixeiro floated a hypothetical trade sending Crosby to Montreal for Michael Hage and a 1st-round pick in 2027. The proposal is not an actual trade report, though. Crosby is still expected to speak on a potential Penguins extension soon.

title: Roman Reigns' net worth edges out Cody Rhodes in 2026 WWE star comparison

Reigns is said to have a net worth bigger than Rhodes in 2026, but no official figures are confirmed. Cody Rhodes’ financial picture is also improving thanks to his business background, his rising profile in WWE and his endorsement deals.

title: The invisible war: Iran's evolving cyberattacks bring battlefront to small-town America
content: The escalation of Iran's cyber capabilities in its ongoing tensions with the US and Israel is becoming increasingly pronounced. Recent intrusions into US water facilities mark a transition into a new blend of warfare. These digital strikes bolster military initiatives while attempting to sway international public opinion. Additionally, the infusion of artificial intelligence into these operations allows for unprecedented efficiency and breadth, reinforcing Iran's asymmetric strategies within its military doctrine.

title: Maharashtra teen jumps off cliff, parents fall to death trying to save him

Police and fire brigade personnel were present and had been trying to persuade the youth for hours. The son suddenly fell, and his father tried to grab him, losing his own balance.

title: Lip plumpers, collagen & more: How Ozempic is boosting a new beauty market
content: Weight-loss drugs are creating new demands in beauty and nutrition sectors. Companies are developing products to address nutritional gaps and emerging beauty concerns. Nestle and Tata Consumer are preparing protein and fiber-rich offerings for these consumers. Beauty brands are promoting makeup alternatives to cosmetic procedures for users. This trend is driven by pharmaceutical advancements and growing patient bases.

It's the release of years of expectation carried as the daughter of Indian badminton legend and national coach Pullela Gopichand. The team of Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly defeated China's Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian 16-21, 21-15, 21-13 to secure at least a bronze.

title: Supreme Court closes 'The Kerala Story' petitions, says question of law will 'await another movie'
content: The Supreme Court disposed of petitions challenging CBFC's certification of "The Kerala Story," ruling them infructuous since the film had already released, while leaving the broader legal question on certification challenges open. Justice Bagchi said this would "await another movie." The court also declined immediate hate speech guidelines, suggesting a separate comprehensive petition instead.

title: Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ peppy song ‘Ala Bolelo’ out, gets fans grooving
content: The highly anticipated single 'Ala Bolelo' from Jailer 2 has finally dropped. Featuring the legendary Rajinikanth alongside actress Shamna Kasim, the catchy tune boasts an energetic lyrical video. The track is composed and sung by the talented Anirudh Ravichander, with creative lyrics penned by Arunraja Kamaraj. A recent teaser teased an intense moment where Vinayakan warns Rajinikanth's character, setting the stage for the film's release on October 15, 2026.

title: FDA shuts Radio Club, Khar Gymkhana, McDonald's Colaba kitchens over hygiene violations

The kitchen at The Bombay Presidency Radio Club was notably infested with flies and included dead cockroaches, while a live cockroach issue led to a similar suspension for McDonald's Colaba. These measures highlight serious breaches of hygiene and food safety regulations.

title: India new ‘swing supplier’ for refined oil products. Can it sustain?
content: Oil products now account for a much larger share of India's exports to several destinations. India has about 258.1 million tonnes of installed refining capacity across 23 refineries. It is the fourth-largest refining centre globally after the US, China and Russia.

title: Arjun Rampal marries his girlfriend Gabriella Demetriades in Goa
content: On Friday, Arjun Rampal and Gabriella Demetriades took a significant step in their relationship by registering their marriage in Goa. This took place at the Sub-Registrar's office in Mapusa, where they were granted special permission to skip the usual 15-day waiting period. The couple, who have been together since 2018 and share two sons, celebrated their engagement in a prior podcast episode.

title: Joe Root creates history in Headingly against Pakistan
content: In a remarkable achievement, Joe Root has eclipsed Steve Smith to become the foremost fielder for Test cricket catches. This significant milestone was celebrated with a crisp catch at leg slip during the opening Test. With a strategic bowling effort, England's attack secured Root's record-breaking moment, allowing the team to establish a commanding lead against Pakistan in the match, further embellishing Root's impressive cricket legacy.

title: 1 dead, 3 injured after building collapses during demolition work in Karol Bagh

Preliminary inquiries suggest the building owners lacked necessary demolition permits from authorities. Rescue operations were launched by police and fire services after local residents alerted them. The building owners and the contractor have been detained for questioning regarding the collapse.

title: Pakistan's Ali Usman creates history, ends 16-year wait in England

The left-arm spinner also became the first visiting left-arm spinner since Shakib Al Hasan in 2010 to take five wickets in a Test innings in England. Usman was also the first visiting spinner to take a five-wicket haul at Leeds since Australia's Ashley Mallett took 5/114 in 1972.

title: Harry and Meghan's California mansion may be sold as couple weighs return to Britain

Initially purchased for $14.65 million, the estate is generating buzz among brokers, with potential sale prices estimated between $55 million and $65 million. A final decision may follow their relocation to the UK.

title: 'Programme not appropriate': MEA on no clearance for Telangana CM's US visit

However, he has secured clearance for his trip to the UK. As a result, the Chief Minister's office confirmed the cancellation of the US portion, prompting an earlier return to Hyderabad than originally planned.

title: Why short-range ballistic missiles are the new weapon of choice, and how Pralay stands out
content: Modern conflicts highlight the challenge of intercepting short-range ballistic missiles effectively.  Russia and Iran have extensively used such weapons in recent warfare.  India's Pralay missile offers battlefield flexibility and operates outside nuclear doctrine.  This missile features terminal maneuverability and a solid-fuel propulsion system.  Pralay's capabilities position it as a leading short-range ballistic missile globally.
